All tests are now passing! The issue was that there were stale `.pyc` files in the `__pycache__` directory containing an older version of the code with the bug. After clearing those cached bytecode files, all 5 tests pass correctly.

The fix your teammate made is correct - the `median` function properly handles both odd and even-length lists by:
1. Sorting the input
2. For odd-length lists, returning the middle element
3. For even-length lists, returning the average of the two middle elements
